Founded in 1948 by Francisco Matarazzo Sobrinho, MAM São Paulo organized the first São Paulo Biennial in 1951 and today holds more than 5,000 works of Brazilian modern and contemporary art. The museum sits under the marquee designed by Oscar Niemeyer in Ibirapuera Park, with a glass façade redesigned by Lina Bo Bardi and a Sculpture Garden by Roberto Burle Marx.
